cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(hello NONE)
set(HELLO_MESSAGE "default message" CACHE STRING "Message written to hello.txt")
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/hello.txt" "${HELLO_MESSAGE}\n")
install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/hello.txt" DESTINATION share/hello)
install(FILES hello.h DESTINATION include/hello)
if(DEFINED ENV{HELLO_PREBUILD_MARKER})
  file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/marker.txt" "$ENV{HELLO_PREBUILD_MARKER}\n")
  install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/marker.txt" DESTINATION share/hello)
endif()
